name: The City: A Multiple Perspective Construct
description: The course analyses city using multiple perspectives – as object, as people, as metaphor, as relationships, as networks, and as an organism; history, sociology, engineering, architecture, geography, economics, and anthropology in cities; drivers and consequences of mass urbanization in India; cities as centers of power, as networks detached from their physical location, functioning as nodes in regional and global networks; spatial design, land use, structures of planning, social, economic and infrastructural networks, urban governance, law and policy, and sustainable development.
